title: Limiting work in progress: finishing before starting

videos.script: A rule on a board says: one item per person, and review before you start anything new. {{rule}} Everybody's first worry is the same. Fewer items open must mean fewer items finished. {{worry}} The Billing team tried it on the third of August. {{date}} Their open work fell to a quarter. Their throughput did not fall. It went up a little. {{result}} And the time each item took fell from about three weeks to four days. {{time}} This lesson measures that change. Then it lets you run the same team again, with the rule switched on in June, or never at all. {{experiment}} After that, it is practical. What to limit, where to start, and what to do when you hit the limit. {{practice}} The answer to that last one is the whole idea. Stop starting, and start finishing. {{finish}}
